results.rationale: A front wheel assembly is added and the board is raised, but the splintered, incomplete front of the deck remains, so the skateboard is only partly completed. The existing grip-surface and exposed decorative pattern are also redrawn, while the gray ground and setting remain matched. Judged alone, the worn board, wheels and contact shadows form a plausible, coherent object.

The original adapter stays on the left while a second smaller adapter appears in front of the cable loop instead of moving the original into its center. The cable and connectors change and the white background becomes a checker pattern. The edit has multiple distracting flaws, including smeared cable connections, a malformed top around the added adapter prongs and ghosted checker texture over the objects.
